title: Realtor.ca Property Scraper
description: Extract property listings from Realtor.ca. Provide a Realtor.ca map URL or use keyword and location filters.

startUrl.title: Realtor.ca URL
startUrl.description: A Realtor.ca map/search URL. Used when no keyword or location is provided.

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional city shortcut. Supported examples: Toronto, Vancouver, Montreal, Calgary, Ottawa, Edmonton. Takes precedence over the Realtor.ca URL when provided.

price_min.title: Minimum price
price_min.description: Minimum listing price in Canadian dollars.

price_max.title: Maximum price
price_max.description: Maximum listing price in Canadian dollars.

size_min.title: Minimum interior size
size_min.description: Minimum interior size in square feet. Realtor.ca matches listings that publish an exact size.

size_max.title: Maximum interior size
size_max.description: Maximum interior size in square feet. Realtor.ca matches listings that publish an exact size.

results_wanted.title: Results wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of property listings to save.

max_pages.title: Max pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of result pages to request.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxies are recommended for Realtor.ca.
